# `crm` commands

## `crm timeline`

One history for a lead and the customer it became: notes, to-dos, files and conversion events, newest first, each labelled "From lead ..." on the customer side. Sources the reader may not read are left out and named. Example: {"lead": "01J..."} or {"customer": "Ada Lane"}.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | member |
| Capability | crm.read |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/crm.timeline` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow crm timeline --lead 01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV --limit 50 --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "crm timeline", "input": {"lead": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV", "limit": 50}, "company": "Company ID or name"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `lead` | `--lead` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Lead ID or exact unambiguous name. |
| `customer` | `--customer` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Customer ID or exact unambiguous name. |
| `limit` | `--limit` | integer | no | no | 50 | minimum 1; maximum 200 |
| `cursor` | `--cursor` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/crm.timeline`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |

| JSON field | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description |

| `items[].from_lead` | string \| null | no | yes | null | The lead this entry came from, when read on a customer. |
| `items[].title` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `items[].status` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `count` | integer | yes | no | — | — |
| `total_count` | integer | yes | no | — | — |
| `has_more` | boolean | yes | no | — | — |

Example JSON output:

```json
{
  "count": 0,
  "customer_id": null,
  "customer_name": null,
  "has_more": false,
  "items": [],
  "lead_id": null,
  "lead_name": null,
  "next_cursor": null,
  "omitted": [],
  "total_count": 1
}
```
